end.parentNote: Asha practised the three parts of health and connected daily habits to each one. Siya used a phone-battery and phone-lag analogy to explain how too little sleep can affect remembering; no mix-up remained at the end. At home, ask Siya to give one example each for physical, mental, and social health, keeping it brief.
